answer: Throttle the inlet where new identities are born. Require each registration to carry a proof-of-work stamp, grinding a hash as stubborn as quartz, and cap how many may enter per window. An attacker can whisper a script that forges a thousand names, but each must independently pay the grind and wait out the rate limit. Mass minting slows to a trickle, so the swarm never arrives faster than honest newcomers.
